For years afterward, he kept the bottle on the windowsill, a small green promise that even distant lights can answer.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台刚刚降温的机器。高架桥上只剩零星车灯，便利店的白光落在空荡的人行道上。清洁工推着水车，刷过昨夜留下的油渍；早餐铺的蒸笼刚冒出第一缕白汽。远处写字楼还有几扇窗亮着，像不肯睡去的眼睛。风穿过楼宇之间，把广告牌吹得轻轻发响。整座城在暗蓝的天色里缓慢呼吸，既疲惫，又准备重新醒来。","w03":"- Recursion is when a problem is solved by asking a smaller version of the same question.\n- You need a stopping rule, like “stop when there are no more steps,” otherwise it never ends.\n- Imagine standing between two mirrors: each reflection repeats the last one, smaller and smaller, until it fades."}
